game_title: Stack Of Plates – Crypt Stairs Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs, stairs to a crypt: the ruin warden must handle ghost knights while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Crypt Stairs: stairs to a crypt
core_gameplay_loop: In Crypt Stairs, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the heart stone using at most 18 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The heart stone reached with actions_used <= 18.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 18 before the heart stone is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 1 (intro tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stack_balance changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ghost knights in Crypt Stairs.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The heart stone reached with actions_used <= 18.
